scripts.build:tsc-all: npm run build -w scoped-event-log -w scoped-event-bus -w asymmetric-io-mutex && npm run build:tsc --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:assets && npm run build:ohif:dev && npm run copy:all && cd interface && npm run build:app
scripts.build:lib:bs: cd interface && cross-env LAUNCHER=brainstatus npm run build:custom
scripts.build:lib:nc: cd interface && cross-env LAUNCHER=nextcloud npm run build:custom
scripts.build:ohif:dev: cd ohif && cross-env PUBLIC_URL=/ohif/ yarn run build && cd .. && npm run copy:ohif && node scripts/convert.js ohif
scripts.build:ohif:nc: cd ohif && cross-env NODE_ENV=production APP_CONFIG=config/nextcloud.js PUBLIC_URL=/apps/epicurrents/ohif/ NX_SKIP_NX_CACHE=true yarn run build && cd .. && node scripts/copy.js ohif --prod && node scripts/convert.js ohif --prod
scripts.start: npm run copy:workers && cd interface && npm run dev
scripts.start:bs: npm run copy:workers && cd interface && cross-env LAUNCHER=brainstatus npm run dev
